❓ Frequently asked questions

What are LinkedIn's character limits?

Post 3,000 · Headline 220 · About section 2,600 · Company page about 2,600 · Message 8,000 · Comment 8,000 · Article headline 100. This tool covers the main writing fields.

Does LinkedIn truncate posts?

Yes — feed posts fold after ~140 characters behind "…see more". Front-load your hook even when you are under the 3,000 limit.

Do line breaks count?

Yes, every character including spaces, line breaks and emoji counts toward the limit.
